😋💣These 8 amazing snacks recipes are gona light up your Diwali week !! 

Bird’s Nest Recipe 🪺

Ingredients

For Nest Mixture:
	•	Boiled Potato – 4 medium (mashed)
	•	Onion – 2–3 tbsp (finely chopped)
	•	Carrot – 2 tbsp (grated)
	•	Green Chilli – 1 (finely chopped)
	•	Ginger – 1 inch (chopped)
	•	Paneer – 40 gm (grated)
	•	Coriander Leaves – 2–3 tbsp (chopped)
	•	Salt – 1 tsp or to taste
	•	Red Chilli Powder – ½ tsp
	•	Chaat Masala – ½ tsp
	•	Roasted Cumin Powder – 1 tsp
	•	Turmeric Powder – ¼ tsp
	•	Bread Crumbs – as needed for binding

For Eggs:
	•	Paneer – 80 gm (grated)
	•	Salt – ½ tsp
	•	Black Pepper – ¼ tsp
	•	Cornflour – 1–1.5 tsp

For Coating:
	•	Maida – 4 tbsp
	•	Cornflour – 3 tbsp
	•	Salt – ½ tsp
	•	Red Chilli Powder – ¼ tsp
	•	Water – as needed
	•	Roasted Vermicelli – for coating

⸻

Method
	1.	Prepare the Nest Mixture
	•	In a bowl, mix mashed potatoes, onion, carrot, green chilli, ginger, paneer, and coriander leaves.
	•	Add salt, red chilli powder, chaat masala, roasted cumin powder, turmeric, and bread crumbs.
	•	Mix well to form a dough-like mixture.
	2.	Prepare the Eggs
	•	In another bowl, combine grated paneer, salt, black pepper, and cornflour.
	•	Shape into small oval balls (like eggs). Keep aside.
	3.	Shape the Nests
	•	Take a portion of the potato mixture and shape into small nests, pressing the center slightly.
	•	Keep the paneer eggs aside to be placed later.
	4.	Coating
	•	Make a slurry with maida, cornflour, salt, red chilli powder, and water (medium consistency).
	•	Dip each nest in the slurry and roll in roasted vermicelli.
	5.	Frying the Nests
	•	Heat oil in a deep pan.
	•	Fry the nests on medium flame until crisp and golden brown.
	•	Remove on paper towels.
	6.	Frying the Eggs
	•	In the same oil, fry the paneer eggs on medium flame .
	•	Drain on paper towels.
	7.	Assembling
	•	Place fried paneer eggs inside the fried nests.
	8.	Serve
	•	Serve hot with ketchup, green chutney, or mayo dip.
